prose: Per Techmeme, sources say Anthropic bought commitments for 1.7GW of gas-fired generators from equipment supplier OnePWR for $3.4B, according to the Financial Times. Basis: the FT article is paywalled, so only the headline is known.
highlights: Reported: 1.7GW of gas-fired generator commitments from OnePWR.
Price reported as $3.4B, per the headline.
basis: FT article paywalled; written from headline only.
